newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUSTRIA CENBANK CALLS FOR REPOS AT UNCH 3.0 PCT.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIA CENBANK CALLS FOR REPOS AT UNCH 3.0 PCT.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements (repos) on Wednesday at an unchanged, fixed rate of three percent.
Bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Thursday, one day early due to a public holiday on Friday, the central bank said.
Last week, the central bank allocated 15.27 billion schillings ($1.2 billion) in repos, filling 12 percent of bids. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257 ($ = 13.11 Austrian Schillings)
